label: May a job take its next step without running the budget dry?
aliases: stop before the money runs out

params.name: has_budget
params.label: The person set a budget for this provider

params.name: left_usd
params.label: What is left of that budget

params.name: step_usd
params.label: What the next step should cost

params.name: stop_when_left_usd
params.label: The floor the budget must not go under

description_nl: TRUE when the next step may run: it is free, or the person set no budget (then Google's own limits are the only brake, and the screen said the cost before the job started), or the budget still has at least stop_when_left_usd after paying for it. A step whose cost would push the budget under that floor makes the job stop cleanly, keeping everything made so far.
weight_basis: Owner's money rule: never spend past the floor the person set. Loosen it only by lowering stop_when_left_usd in jobs.partial.
